title: Heat and Reweigh a Carbonate Mixture

nodes.title: Choose a balance
nodes.description: Put balance A on the bench and make every weighing in this run on it: two balances never read exactly alike.

feedback.retry: Review Choose a balance and try again.

nodes.title: Zero the balance
nodes.description: With the pan empty and the draft-shield doors closed, check that the balance reads 0.000 g, and press TARE if it does not.

feedback.retry: Review Zero the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Put the crucible on the balance
nodes.description: Put the clean, dry, cool crucible with its lid on balance A's pan.

feedback.success: Put the crucible on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put the crucible on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read its mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the empty crucible and lid's mass.

feedback.retry: Review Read its mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the mass
nodes.description: Record the empty crucible and lid's mass in your notebook.

feedback.retry: Review Record the mass and try again.

nodes.title: Add the mixture
nodes.description: With the crucible on the pan, tap about {{config.sampleMassG}} g of the mixture from its vial into the crucible.

feedback.retry: Review Add the mixture and try again.

nodes.title: Read the loaded mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the crucible, lid and mixture's mass.

validation.label: Read the loaded mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the loaded mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the loaded mass
nodes.description: Record the loaded mass in your notebook.

validation.label: Record the loaded mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Record the loaded mass and try again.

nodes.title: Return the unused mixture
nodes.description: Tip what is left in the vial into the beaker labelled "Unused Sample". Unheated mixture and heated product go to separate labelled beakers.

feedback.retry: Review Return the unused mixture and try again.

nodes.title: Stand the ring stand
nodes.description: Stand the ring stand on the bench.

feedback.retry: Review Stand the ring stand and try again.

nodes.title: Seat the clay triangle
nodes.description: Rest the clay triangle on the iron ring.

feedback.retry: Review Seat the clay triangle and try again.

nodes.title: Place the burner
nodes.description: Stand the Bunsen burner on the base beneath the ring.

feedback.retry: Review Place the burner and try again.

nodes.title: Set the crucible on the support
nodes.description: Take the crucible off the balance and stand it in the clay triangle.

feedback.success: Set the crucible on the support complete.
feedback.retry: Review Set the crucible on the support and try again.

nodes.title: Set the lid askew
nodes.description: Set the lid askew, leaving a gap. Never heat a fully covered crucible.

validation.label: Set the lid askew was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Set the lid askew and try again.

nodes.title: Light the burner
nodes.description: Close the air collar almost fully, turn on the gas, and light it with the striker at the top of the barrel.

feedback.retry: Review Light the burner and try again.

nodes.title: Set the flame
nodes.description: Open the air collar until the flame is blue, with an inner cone.

feedback.retry: Review Set the flame and try again.

nodes.title: Warm the mixture gently with the lid askew
nodes.description: Warm the crucible gently first.

validation.label: Warm the mixture gently with the lid askew was completed.

feedback.success: Warm the mixture gently with the lid askew complete.
feedback.retry: Review Warm the mixture gently with the lid askew and try again.

nodes.title: Heat the mixture
nodes.description: Heat the crucible for the set time.

feedback.retry: Review Heat the mixture and try again.

nodes.title: Turn off the burner
nodes.description: Turn the gas off before you move the crucible.

validation.label: Turn off the burner was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Turn off the burner and try again.

nodes.title: Move it with tongs
nodes.description: Lift the hot crucible with the crucible tongs onto the heat-safe pad.

feedback.retry: Review Move it with tongs and try again.

nodes.title: Let it cool
nodes.description: Leave it on the pad until it is cool enough to weigh.

feedback.retry: Review Let it cool and try again.

nodes.title: Put it on the balance
nodes.description: Put the cool crucible on balance A's pan.

feedback.success: Put it on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put it on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read the cooled mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the mass.

validation.label: Read the cooled mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the cooled mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the cooled mass
nodes.description: Record the mass in your notebook.

validation.label: Record the cooled mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Record the cooled mass and try again.

nodes.title: Set it back on the support
nodes.description: Stand the crucible back in the clay triangle, the lid still askew.

feedback.success: Set it back on the support complete.
feedback.retry: Review Set it back on the support and try again.

nodes.title: Light the burner
nodes.description: Light the burner again, the air collar almost closed.

feedback.retry: Review Light the burner and try again.

nodes.title: Set the flame
nodes.description: Open the air collar to a blue flame.

feedback.retry: Review Set the flame and try again.

nodes.title: Heat it again
nodes.description: Heat the crucible again for the same time.

feedback.retry: Review Heat it again and try again.

nodes.title: Turn off the burner
nodes.description: Turn the gas off.

validation.label: Turn off the burner was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Turn off the burner and try again.

nodes.title: Move it with tongs
nodes.description: Lift the crucible with the tongs onto the heat-safe pad.

feedback.retry: Review Move it with tongs and try again.

nodes.title: Let it cool
nodes.description: Leave it on the pad until it is cool enough to weigh.

feedback.retry: Review Let it cool and try again.

nodes.title: Put it on the balance
nodes.description: Put the cool crucible on balance A's pan.

feedback.success: Put it on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put it on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read the mass again
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the mass, then compare it with the first cooled mass. When the two agree, the mass is constant.

validation.label: Read the mass again was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the mass again and try again.

nodes.title: Record the final mass
nodes.description: Record the constant final mass in your notebook.

validation.label: Record the final mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Record the final mass and try again.

nodes.title: Recover the product
nodes.description: Tip the cool product into the beaker labelled "Product Made from Heating Samples".

feedback.retry: Review Recover the product and try again.

nodes.title: Work out the composition
nodes.description: From the mass lost, work out the masses of sodium hydrogen carbonate and sodium carbonate in the mixture.

validation.label: Work out the composition was submitted.

feedback.retry: Review Work out the composition and try again.
